refreshNotes: Refreshed April 29, 2026 from official Metro Detroit farm event pages, public web-search result snippets, and attempted public Facebook event pages. Direct Facebook event pages returned public error pages in this environment and Bing search was challenge-gated, so the feed favors official farm/event pages that could be verified. Added Blake Farms' Mother's Day brunches, Tales & Cocktails, Sauce Off, and Little Sprouts listings; re-verified DeBuck's, Blake's bloom events, Upland Hills, Maybury Farm Fest, and Eastern Market flower events.
